textRuns.value: Top 3 Cost Drivers (Cost Pool): Labour $12.4M (31%), Public Cloud $9.3M (23%), HW Depreciation $6.3M (16%) — together ~70% of total spend. By product, the top 3 are Compute $20.1M, Database $4.8M, and End-User $3.8M.

Notable variances: Compute is under budget and improving each month (-9.8% / -19.0% / -21.2% vs budget). Database is increasingly favorable (-19.6% / -36.9% / -39.8%). Cloud Platform is the only product consistently over budget all quarter, but narrowing toward breakeven (+14.0% / +9.8% / +1.4%).

Data gaps: Network has no actual/budget/forecast row for February. Storage, End-User, and Security lose budget/forecast coverage in later months, so their variance figures for those periods should be read as directional, not final.
